components.name: proposition
values: in the cellular context generalization scenario trvae cellot and invae demonstrated the best overall performance on single-condition datasets.

components.name: proposition
values: when predicting perturbation effects in a new cellular context that is substantially different from training contexts all methods performed poorly even worse than baseline models.

components.name: proposition
values: for genetic combined-perturbation prediction linearmodel and scouter perform the best.

components.name: proposition
values: for chemical single-perturbation prediction chemcpa is the preferred choice.

components.name: proposition
values: all methods performed poorly on population-distribution metrics particularly common-degs in genetic perturbation scenarios.

components.name: proposition
values: deep learning models including foundation models have limited generalizability especially for strong perturbations and heterogeneous perturbations.

components.name: proposition
values: for chemical combined-perturbation prediction basereg baseline model achieves highest accuracy.

components.name: proposition
values: for genetic single-perturbation prediction genepert is optimal when training data is small cpa and scgpt are preferable when fine-tuning data is large.

components.name: observation
values: performance advantage of cpa over trainmean increased as similarity between test and training perturbations decreased.

components.name: observation
values: scpram is optimal for accurate prediction of the top most differentially expressed genes.

components.name: observation
values: cpa achieved the highest accuracy in terms of both mse and pcc-delta on replogle-rpe1essential and replogle-k562essential datasets.

components.name: method
values: chemcpa | predicting cellular responses to novel drug perturbations at single-cell resolution.
cpa | predicting cellular responses to complex perturbations in high-throughput screens.
gears | predicting transcriptional outcomes of novel multigene perturbations with knowledge graphs.
genepert | simple and effective embedding model for single-cell biology built from chatgpt.
scgpt | foundation model for single-cell multi-omics using generative ai.
scouter | predicting transcriptional responses to genetic perturbations with llm embeddings.

values: cellot | learning single-cell perturbation responses using neural optimal transport.

scpram | attention-based prediction of single-cell gene expression perturbation response.
scvidr | generative modeling for dose-dependent chemical perturbations.
trvae | conditional out-of-distribution generation using transfer vae.
